gist.summary: Documented POST /v1/systemone on gen.pollinations.ai as TypeSafe’s System One path for clients that append it to a base URL. It accepts the same request and returns the same response as POST /alpha/decisions, with the same models and billing. Added request and response field tables and a curl example showing state, keyed questions, and the optional model field, which defaults to jev.
